scenarios.name: Open Document Settings from the full Tools ribbon

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/blank-metric-part.opd` is open with the full Tools ribbon displayed in the MCAD Software
the active part's Document Settings dialog opens
the dialog shows Standard, Units, Sketch, Modeling, Bill of Materials and Default Tolerance tabs
Close is available while Cancel and Apply are unavailable
the user closes the dialog without changing settings
the Tools ribbon and active part remain visible
